data_quality_note: This dataset contains two classes of WEAK supervision signals: (a) AI-critic-guided improvement pairs with incomplete rejected artifact (confidence=0.5, source=critique_guided_incomplete; analogous to RAFT/Constitutional AI, NOT suitable as standard DPO trainer input without the missing rejected text); (b) Human-review single samples lacking a paired counterpart for the same prompt (confidence=0.9, source=human_review; may serve as a weak signal for offline preference analysis or single-side classification, subject to scale caveats; NOT standard DPO). A third class, complete_pairs (source=critique_guided_complete), carries BOTH sides (pre-revision snapshot vs post-revision artifact, improvement-pair semantics) and is DPO-format compatible for downstream experiments. This export does NOT train, fine-tune, produce model weights, or change OWCopilot's runtime model. It only exists for trails recorded after RefineStep.artifact_before landed. Sample count is expected to be small for development-scale projects. This is a data-pipeline demonstration, not a production training dataset.
